name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Pineapple Express
description: Famous for a reason, Pineapple Express combines tangy pineapple with tropical sweetness for a flavor that’s as vibrant as its effects. This sativa 2g disposable delivers a wave of uplifting, energetic vibes that are perfect for fueling creativity, sparking conversation, or keeping the good times rolling. With every smooth pull, you’ll see why Pineapple Express has earned its legendary status.
